trailhead.label: San Rocco in Peio Paese, by the military cemetery, the board’s start

cautions: Minor village road at the start and end in Peio Paese: keep your dog on a short lead.
The forest road to the Covel meadows is open to cars for about 1 km: keep your dog close if one comes.
Goats and sheep graze at Malga Covel in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Peio Paese to Lago Covel: Da Peio Paese al Lago Covel
textIt.San Rocco in Peio Paese, by the military: San Rocco a Peio Paese, accanto al cimitero militare, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.Minor village road at the start and end: Strada di paese all’inizio e alla fine a Peio Paese: tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.The forest road to the Covel meadows is: La strada forestale verso i prati di Covel è aperta alle auto per circa 1 km: tieni il cane vicino se ne arriva una.
textIt.Goats and sheep graze at Malga Covel in: In estate a Malga Covel pascolano capre e pecore.
